threads.body: [General] The PR title and description describe only Mongo 3.x consolidation, but this settings change also starts consolidating Akka, Kotlin Coroutines Flow, and Ratpack modules. Those changes alter user-facing v3-preview selectors (and Ratpack scope behavior) without being disclosed, so reviewers and users cannot evaluate the actual compatibility surface. Please split the unrelated families into separate PRs as requested by #20189, or update the title and description with each family's selector and telemetry migration details.
`mongo-3.1-core-3.7` is weird, hard to see the logic behind this name. The same for the `v3_1.core.v3_7` package. I guess it is fine since the package name is an internal implementation detail.
